DitherUptimeBar.label: The service, such as "API".
DitherUptimeBar.days: One entry per day, oldest first. Each has a date ("2026-10-13"), an uptime from 0 to 1 (negative for no data) and an optional note for the tooltip.
DitherUptimeBar.fill: Texture of the up days. Degraded days are always hatched, outages solid and days without data dotted.
DitherUptimeBar.bloom: low or high adds a glow behind degraded days and outages, so incidents stand out.
DitherUptimeBar.none-color: Colour of the days without data.
